title: Surprise Planning Lead Time
dataSources: Shared calendar events (`sharedcalendar:event`), gift budget items (`giftbudget:item`), touchpoint logs (`touchpoint:log`), and relationship rituals (`relationship:ritual`).
app: Relationship and togetherness telemetry from shared calendars, gift budgets, message and call logs, and long-distance touchpoint trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftbudget:item
| search surprise="true" lead_time_days=*
| stats avg(lead_time_days) as avg_lead_time_days perc90(lead_time_days) as p90_lead_time_days count as samples by occasion
| sort 0 - avg_lead_time_days
description: Measures surprise planning lead time by occasion.
value: Lead time helps show whether surprises are being planned calmly or assembled under deadline pressure.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for surprise planning lead time to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 surprise planning lead time.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how long surprise planning lead time usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
